points.text: States pressure = force / area and divides 200 by 0.5
Gives a pressure of 400 Pa with unit

items.prompt: A crate of weight 200 N rests on a face of area 0.5 square metres. Calculate the pressure on the ground.

points.text: States moment = force x distance from the pivot and multiplies 60 by 0.5
Gives a moment of 30 N·m with unit

items.prompt: A weight of 60 N sits 0.5 m from a pivot. Calculate its moment.

points.text: States speed = distance / time and divides 100 by 20
Gives 5 m/s and states a direction must be given for a velocity

items.prompt: An athlete sprints 100 metres in 20 seconds. Calculate her speed, and state the one extra fact that turns that speed into a velocity.

points.text: States the height of the line is the velocity, so flat at 12 m/s means the velocity stays at 12 m/s
States a constant velocity means the object keeps moving at the same speed, not that it has stopped

items.prompt: A velocity-time graph runs flat at 12 m/s for ten seconds. Explain why the object has not stopped.

levels.descriptor: Explanations chain force, moment and graph readings to the answer in order, with each step justified by a named net-force, moment or gradient rule.
levels.label: Secure

levels.descriptor: Explanations are broadly sound but one link between the forces or the graph and the answer is asserted rather than justified.
levels.label: Developing

levels.descriptor: Answers state numbers or force names without connecting them into an explanation.
levels.label: Beginning
